--- page 5 ---
AZERA LUXURY
PERCEIVING IS
BELIEVING.
Listen to your senses. They’ll tell you all you
need to know about Hyundai Azera.
The sensations Azera inspires flow from many sources: The supple leather seats.
The 3D Carbon Fiber-inspired trim. An available panoramic sunroof up above,
and blue ambient lighting down below. Step into Azera, and you’ll immediately
sense how large and welcoming it is. Azera Limited treats both front and rear-seat
passengers to heated leather seats. The front seats are also ventilated for comfort
in every climate and feature an Integrated Memory System for individualized seat,
side mirror and steering column settings.
Grip the leather-wrapped steering wheel, and Azera conveys another strong
sensation: Control. Switches on the wheel give the driver fingertip command
over the audio, Bluetooth® and cruise control systems. Your ears will also delight
in the impeccable clarity of Azera’s audio technologies. An available 550-Watt
Infinity® Logic7® Surround Sound premium audio system uses 14 speakers and
a subwoofer to create rich, full sound no matter where you’re seated. It’s perfect
for enjoying your choice of HD Radio,™ SiriusXM® Satellite Radio, Bluetooth audio
streaming from your smartphone, or music mixes from your iPod.®1

--- page 7 ---
AZERA ENGINEERING
STYLE IS NOTHING
WITHOUT SUBSTANCE.
What Azera promises on the surface,
it delivers in performance.
Look past the available Xenon HID headlights, with that necklace of LED lights.
Just behind those glittering eyes is the soul of Azera: A powerful, clean and
efficient 3.3L V6 engine that uses advanced technologies like Gasoline Direct
Injection and Continuously Variable Valve Timing to create a win-win situation
– a robust 293 horsepower for responsive acceleration with impressive fuel
economy. At the press of a button, Azera’s Active ECO System modifies engine
and transmission controls to smooth out shift points and help optimize fuel
efficiency even further.
A motor-driven power steering system lends Azera a best-of-both-worlds steering
feel: Lighter at lower speeds for easy maneuverability, and progressively more firm
as your speed increases. There’s no compromise when it comes to your safety,
either. The 2013 Azera was named an IIHS Top Safety Pick, thanks to high marks
derived from a well-designed chassis, a 9-airbag protection system with a driver’s
knee airbag, and an advanced Vehicle Stability Management system.1
